title: Fatima ki amanat
body:
Ya Husain ya husain
Sada rahega husain ka ghum - 4
Ye fatema ki amanat hai Itna yaad rakho - 2
Ghume husain nayi nasl ke supurd karo
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye Fatima ki amanat hai itna yaad rakho.
Ye kehke laao juluso me Apne Bacho ko - 2
Apne Bacho ko
Chalo hamare qadam se qadam Mila ke chalo
<<DIVIDER>>
Mila tha Jaise buzurgo se tumko wese hi - 2
Tumko wese hi
Alam Jawano k hatho me Apne haath se do
Barange majliso matam barange zikre husain - 2
<<DIVIDER>>
Barange zikre husain
Imame waqt se Har waqt raabte me raho
Ye baabe Tauba khula hai Har ek hurr k liye - 2
Har ek hurr k liye
<<DIVIDER>>
Imaam Baara k darwazo Par ye baat likho
Ye kya karenge dhamake imam saath hai jab - 2
Imam saath hai jab
Hato na piche azadaro Aur Aage badho
<<DIVIDER>>
Khilaaf matame shabbir Jo zaba khole - 2
Jo zaba khole
Koi jawab na do sirf
Ya husain kaho
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye khaab me Ali akbar behen se kehte the - 2
Ham aaye hai tumhe Lene
Hamare sath Chalo
Khudara rok le khanjar theher ja ae zaalim - 2
<<DIVIDER>>
Theher jaa ae zaalim
Na zibha saamne behno ke
Kar baraadar ko
Utho Jo farshe aza se to sar utha ke Chalo - 2
<<DIVIDER>>
Sar utha ke Chalo
Yaha pe aao takallum to
Sar jhuka ke rakho
